content: One future direction of interest is to combine our approach with existing work to reduce the number of layers in the student models and explore other approaches such as low-rank matrix factorization to transfer model parameters from the teacher space to the student space. In addition, taking into account the frequency distribution of the WordPiece tokens while training embeddings may help optimize the model size further.
